The '''Sacorrian Security Police''' was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. It was mainly composed of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]].
